Self-hosted libraries used by the HR page (src/js/modules/hr.js). Unmodified upstream files, MIT licence. Nothing is loaded from a CDN (see the CSP).
- fullcalendar.global.min.js, fullcalendar-th.global.min.js : FullCalendar 6.1.8 (https://fullcalendar.io) — calendar + Thai locale
- flatpickr.min.js, flatpickr-th.js (+ ../../css/flatpickr.min.css) : flatpickr 4.6.13 (https://flatpickr.js.org) — time picker + Thai locale
